name: Sanity Activity Log API
description:
Use the Activity Log API to retrieve activity events for Sanity
organizations, projects, users, and related resources.

Requests use a version path: `/v2021-02-01`, any later date in the
form `/vYYYY-MM-DD`, or `/vX`, which all behave the same. Results are returned
in reverse chronological order by `timestamp`.
